verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows general analytics: Insights analyzes every conversation, and AI Recommendations and Monitors are said to help 'understand, measure, and improve' the customer experience. No cited item says the platform identifies knowledge gaps (unanswered or poorly answered topics) or flags conflicting or contradictory content. Generic analytics is an adjacent feature, not documented support for this story, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions
